steps.js: const d=window.__dbg,s=d.state; for(const f of ['benzin','dizel','lpg']) s.tanks[f]=s.fuelCapacity(f); for(let i=0;i<s.pumps;i++) s.autoPumps.add(i); for(let i=0;i<s.evChargers;i++) s.autoChargers.add(i); s.battery=s.batteryCapacity; for(const c of [...d.cars.cars]) if(!c.guest&&c.phase!=='transit') d.cars.releaseCar(c); const ease=k=>k<.5?2*k*k:-1+(4-2*k)*k; window.__camTo=(x,y,z,ms)=>new Promise(r=>{const c=d.cine.getCam(),t0=performance.now();const f=()=>{const k=Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/ms),e=ease(k);d.cine.setCam(c.x+(x-c.x)*e,c.y+(y-c.y)*e,c.zoom+(z-c.zoom)*e);k<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):r()};f()}); window.__follow=(id,z,maxMs,dy)=>new Promise(r=>{const t0=performance.now();const f=()=>{const c=d.cars.cars.find(c=>c.guest?.id===id);const cam=d.cine.getCam();if(c){const p=c.group.position;d.cine.setCam(cam.x+(p.x-cam.x)*.12,cam.y+((p.y+(dy||0))-cam.y)*.12,cam.zoom+(z-cam.zoom)*.08)}const done=!c||c.phase==='atPump'||performance.now()-t0>maxMs;done?r():requestAnimationFrame(f)};f()}); window.__camToCar=(id,z,ms,dy)=>{const c=d.cars.cars.find(c=>c.guest?.id===id);if(!c)return Promise.resolve();const p=c.group.position;return window.__camTo(p.x,p.y+(dy||0),z,ms)};
